messages:
Devin: quick sanity check — I brought up a quantized reranker on the OpenQA-sampled-40k holdout, posting the short summary below. need thoughts on stats + whether formatting might explain the dip.

Devin: run details: model=rerank-3b-q4f (group128), baseline=rerank-3b-fp16, doc trunc=512 tokens, query norm=lower+strip-punct, doc format='title ||| body'

eval-bot: eval run finished (id=exp-1793456789): NDCG@10 baseline=0.412, q4f=0.407 (delta=-0.005, -1.2%), MRR@10 baseline=0.367 -> q4f=0.363 (delta=-0.004, -1.1%). Paired bootstrap (10k iters) p=0.042 for NDCG delta.

Ying: can you paste exact formatting? title + body concatenation vs newline? tokenization details?

Devin: we concatenated as `title ||| body` (literal separator). also tried `title

body` variant in ablation but main run used the pipe sep. tokenizer=sentencepiece cased, vocab shared.

Sarah: digging into slices: the negative delta is concentrated on long queries (>40 tokens) and long docs. tail bucket (long-query x long-doc) NDCG drop = 0.038 absolute (3.8%). short queries (<10 tokens) are flat or slightly up.

Omar: quant profile: q4f for all weights, group size 128; attention uses fused int kernels. long contexts could be suffering from increased attention score variance when quantized. I can re-run with `q4_0_for_attn=true` to keep attention matrices in a different quant regime.

Devin: i also ran stats: paired per-query bootstrap (10k) mean delta = -0.005, 95% CI = [-0.009, -0.001] (borderline). Wilcoxon signed-rank p=0.06. so bootstrap says significant-ish, wilcoxon not quite — small effect size but consistent in tail.

Ying: suggested ablations: (A) title + first-120 tokens only, (B) title + first-sentence, (C) original. that should isolate whether doc-length truncation + separator interacts with quant noise.

eval-bot: queued follow-ups: 1793456801 -> q4_0_attn re-run, 1793456802 -> title-first-120 ablation, 1793456803 -> paired-bootstrap-50k-resamples. ETA ~2 hours.

Sarah: action items: Omar -> run q4_0_attn + upload raw logits and per-query deltas; Devin -> re-run paired-bootstrap with 50k resamples and attach CI; Ying -> prepare ablation (A/B table) and add to dashboard. I'll triage results and decide on hybrid quant profile. @Omar @Ying

Omar: :thumbsup: starting now. FYI kernel fallback might add ~3% latency, will note p99.

Devin: if q4_0_attn recovers tail we can consider a hybrid profile (keep top-k attention layers at q4_0 or fp16). also add these tests to nightly regression so small drifts don't slip by.

Sarah: sg. i'll draft a short playbook note once we confirm, including which metrics to monitor (NDCG@10 global + tail bucket, delta CI, mean per-query delta).

Devin: thanks — I'll post the experiment links when they finish and flag any surprising per-query examples that drive the CI.

Omar: linked the first logs: `s3://redwood-eval/exp-1793456801/logs.tar.gz` (contains per-query scores + raw logits).

Ying: prepping the ablation now, will push results to the rerank dashboard under 'quantization-ablation/1793456789'

Sarah: perfect — keep notes short in the ticket so we can decide fast. if we need a rollback path for hosted customers, we should outline it now.
